Preserve reference cart wheel position, rail lengths, covered-load depth and perspective as closely as possible. No sword in hands, no back weapon, flower, leopard tattoo, black body spots, yellow moustache, long Gongsun beard, double buns, head crown or shoes.
Composition: one square atlas with FOUR DISTINCT complete separate isometric 3/4 views. Top left SE facing down-right, top right SW down-left, bottom left NE up-right showing back, bottom right NW up-left showing back. Each quadrant contains one full actor+one cart. Nothing touches or crosses gutters. Include every toe, headcloth tail, wheel and both handle tips. No grid lines, no labels, no letters, no extra scene, no cast shadows on any floor.
Background: genuinely transparent RGBA, zero-alpha empty outer margins/corners and central gutters, no tinted or opaque background, no checkerboard baked in. Preserve clean alpha.
Pose for THIS atlas only: PUSH IDLE. Balanced planted bare feet, both knees soft but no stepping. Upright strong torso leaning slightly toward cart, each hand grips its own handle. All four directions show the same neutral waiting phase. Reference image 1 is authoritative Ruan full-body identity and clothing/feet; image 2 is authoritative Ruan face; image 3 is cart, composition, camera and idle hand-placement reference ONLY. Replace the reference cart actor completely with Ruan Xiaoer. Generate new native original PNG.
